<!-- move awakenawakennomi:kenzan_world -->

### Kenzan World { #awakening-kenzan-world }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/supa/kenzan_world.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Turns the ground into blades that cut enemies walking on it, and every cut makes them bleed more. Sprinting doubles the damage, crouching halves it and does not make the bleeding worse, only flying off the ground gets away from it.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base damage | 8 HP |
| Cooldown | 120 s (2400 ticks) |

</div>

### Razor Cyclone { #awakening-razor-cyclone }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/supa/razor_cyclone.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user turns into a whirlwind of blades that moves forward, cutting every enemy it goes through and making them bleed. Inside the user's Kenzan World the whirlwind is bigger and hits harder.

### Steel Riposte { #awakening-steel-riposte }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/supa/steel_riposte.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user hardens their steel body for a moment and the first hit that lands in that time is fully blocked. Then the user appears behind the attacker and cuts them, making them bleed.
